notes.title: Update Information（10/04/2017）
notes.notes:
・Traditional Chinese language support was added.
・The menu item "Vibration" under "Settings" - "Controls" has been removed.
・The content of some messages has been corrected.

notes.title: Update Information (2017/07/21)
notes.notes:
Update ver. 1.0.1.0 released.

Corrected an issue in which, at castle towns, NPCs were sometimes positioned such that it was impossible for the player character to talk to them.
